mutations.limits: Exploratory critic runner restored function definitions sequentially in a private disposable cluster. It did not mutate schema DDL/indexes and does not constitute an exhaustive mutation score.

limitations: Finite generated workflow and concurrency schedules do not prove absence of all defects.
Used trusted-owner fixture writes only for setup/fault injection; arbitrary schema-owner corruption is outside runtime threat model.
Lot expiry/FEFO and disabled location policy belong to application guard/allocation rules per documented contract, not newly inferred kernel authorization.
No production throughput, HA or power-loss guarantee was measured.
Other critics cover module authorization, worker leases, recovery and API/OIDC; this report only claims the listed accounting scope.

The replay snapshot includes balances, documents, lines and operation/movement/audit/outbox counts; it does not compare every reservation-event payload. Reservation totals and release-event quantities are checked separately.
